qualifiers.scope: across all on-demand streams in the account
qualifiers.condition: On-demand Advantage is an account-level setting; enabling it commits the account to a minimum data ingest and data retrieval

evidence.quote: For pricing, there's no longer a fixed charge for each stream. Data ingest, data retrieval, and extended retention usage across all on-demand streams are at least 60% lower than in On-demand Standard.
On-demand Advantage is an account-level setting that unlocks more capabilities and provides a different pricing structure for all on-demand streams in an AWS Region.
Enabling On-demand Advantage commits the account to at least 25MiB/s of data ingest and 25MiB/s of data retrieval across all on-demand streams.
